findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "log_event" is 1402 chars, far longer than this server's median (161). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

evidence.snippet: MUTATES the authenticated user calendar. Use for non-food days — funeral, cremation, appointment, dinner, anything that is not a food log. Do not store this as …

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "search" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Search the authenticated user life graph. Deterministic routing first: food + relative dates (e.g. "what did I eat yesterday?"); timeline/current-context; money…

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow.
